snippet.title: [Cyan Heart] a selfie perspective horror | Demo release Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Cyan Heart demo is now on Steam!
And I'll be participating in Steam Next Fest too.
storepage↓
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744190/Cyan_Heart/

A horror exploration puzzle adventure experienced through a “selfie perspective.” Alone, relying only on voice communications from your comrades, you simply keep the camera rolling. Bear witness to the record she wanted to leave behind.

#CyanHeart #steamnextfest #indiegame
